title: Nutty Crunchy Croatian Beef Skewers
description: A hearty, hangover-cure Croatian dish featuring a mix of beef cuts, crunchy walnuts, and a hint of nutmeg, all poached to perfection in a flavorful broth.

ingredients.name: beef strips (1.5 pounds)
ingredients.notes: mix of chuck, sirloin, and round

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips and toss to coat.
Thread the beef onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the beef for 1-2 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a large pot and add the chopped onion, garlic, and chopped walnuts.
Pour in the chicken broth and red wine vinegar, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and poach for 20-25 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through.
Remove the beef from the pot and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve hot, drizzled with lemon juice and garnished with fresh parsley.
